description:
FRONT GARDEN		
T1	Mimosa (Acacia dealbata)	Crown reduce by approximately 1-2m, back to most recent previous reduction points.
        Final height 6m and spread 5m.		

T2	Judas Tree (Cercis siliquastrum)	Crown reduce by approximately 1-1.5m back to most recent previous reduction points.
        Final height 5m and spread 3.5m.	

T3	Elm (Ulmus spp)	Crown reduce by approximately 1-1.5m back to most recent previous reduction points.
        Final height 5m and spread 3m.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The proposed work is to be carried out to British Standard 3998 (2010) Tree Work Recommendations, by a reputable tree surgeon to the satisfaction of the Tree Preservation Officer who should be informed of the date of commencement of work.
